author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to what many are calling a blatant media spin surrounding the NYC bombing incident. Early coverage pushed a specific narrative, but as more details surfaced, that version of events quickly started to fall apart. The issue isn’t just getting it wrong; it’s how confidently the story was framed before the facts were clear. Russell breaks down how the narrative was shaped, who it benefited, and why so many people are now questioning whether this was misinformation or something more deliberate.
